title: 多肉小憩
description:
Welcome to your own desktop greenhouse. 

In the gaps between work and daily life, pixel succulents grow quietly. No pressure, no complex mechanics — just a little patience to watch your succulents bloom with color.

• A Relaxed Care Routine

Follow the natural rule of "water only when dry." Watch for wilting leaves and water at just the right moment to bring your succulents back to life.

• A Rich Succulent Collection

Unlock your succulent collection and nurture every variety to its most beautiful state!

• Style Your Way

Collect all kinds of charming pots and shelves to create a unique growing environment for each succulent.

• Fun Leaf Propagation Gacha

Interact with succulents of different colors, collect fallen leaves, and try your luck at the leaf propagation gacha.
description_short: Grow all kinds of succulents right on your desktop! Succulent Break is a relaxing simulation game where you can tend to your succulents in the corner of your screen, pair each one with the perfect pot and soil, water them at just the right moment, and watch them grow more beautiful than ever!
